gates.name: NoHallucination
gates.description: Description does not mention people, animals, or objects listed in verified_absent

gates.name: SubjectMatch
gates.description: Primary subject keywords appear in the description (>=40% = full credit, >=20% = partial)

gates.name: PersonCount
gates.description: Person count stated matches ground truth; skipped when person_count = -1

gates.name: SettingMatch
gates.description: Setting/location keywords appear in the description (>=30% = full credit). Low threshold due to vocabulary variation.

gates.name: KeyObjects
gates.description: Key objects from ground truth appear in the description (>=50% = full, >=25% = partial)

gates.name: NoFillerOpener
gates.description: Description does not begin with a banned filler phrase

gates.name: ProperLength
gates.description: Description is between 15 and 150 words (not too terse, not a repetition loop)
